title: Credentials and agent identities
description: Use when managing LPM credentials (credenciais, chave de API): API keys and profiles, lpm_mcp_ agent credentials, agent principals, specialist assignments, AI provider keys, the workspace GitHub token. Writes are owner-only; secrets never printed. Not for a missing connector tool (use lpm-start).
doneWhen: The credential object is in the requested state (re-listed), any show-once secret was handed over once, and no secret appears in any other output.
authorityCeiling: Reads are [A]; all 14 writes are [O]; secrets are shown once to the requester and never repeated.
